description: This file implements a custom memory management utility with functions for initializing, acquiring, releasing, and querying memory blocks, as well as copying and checking memory contents. It also includes a unit test for the memory functions.

methods.name: mem_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory pool, setting up a free list and storing the count of free blocks.

methods.name: mem_acquire
methods.description: Allocates a block from the free list, updating the free count.

methods.name: mem_release
methods.description: Releases a memory block back to the free list, updating the free count.

methods.name: mem_free_count_get
methods.description: Returns the number of free memory blocks.

methods.name: mem_get
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a memory block at a specific index within the pool.

methods.name: mem_index_get
methods.description: Calculates the index of a memory block within the pool.

methods.name: mem_rcopy
methods.description: Copies bytes from source to destination in reverse order.

methods.name: mem_nz
methods.description: Checks if the memory contains any non-zero bytes.

methods.name: mem_ut
methods.description: Unit test function for the memory management utilities.
